item.title: Macfarlane Group: this Thursday’s Interim Results could show positivity for the second-half, with even brighter prospects for 2027
item.summary: After the recently announced de-risking of its pension scheme, investors are getting more optimistic about the prospects for the Macfarlane Group (LON:MACF). We look forward to the company declaring positive comments when the leading protective packaging solutions group announces its Interim Results this coming Thursday, 27th August. Capitalised at some £112m, the business this year is estimated to push sales up to £308m, with £16.2m adjusted pre-tax […] The post Macfarlane Group: this Thursday’s Interim Results could show positivity for the second-half, with even brighter prospects for 2027 appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
